columns.name: Número do Documento
columns.legacyExpression:
CASE 
        WHEN fpc.numero_cte IS NOT NULL THEN CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), fpc.numero_cte)
        WHEN fpc.numero_nfse IS NOT NULL THEN CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), fpc.numero_nfse)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS [Número do Documento]

columns.name: Status do Processo
columns.legacyExpression: CASE WHEN fpc.fit_ant_document IS NOT NULL THEN 'Faturado' ELSE 'Aguardando Faturamento' END AS [Status do Processo]

columns.name: Documento Oficial/Tipo
columns.legacyExpression:
CASE 
        WHEN f.cte_id IS NOT NULL
          OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(f.chave_cte)), '') IS NOT NULL
          OR f.numero_cte IS NOT NULL
          OR f.serie_cte IS NOT NULL THEN 'CT-e'
        WHEN f.nfse_number IS NOT NULL
          OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(f.nfse_series)), '') IS NOT NULL
          OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(f.nfse_xml_document)), '') IS NOT NULL
          OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(f.nfse_integration_id)), '') IS NOT NULL THEN 'NFS-e'
        ELSE 'Pendente/Não Emitido'
    END AS [Documento Oficial/Tipo]

columns.name: Documento Oficial/Chave
columns.legacyExpression:
CASE 
        WHEN f.cte_id IS NOT NULL
          OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(f.chave_cte)), '') IS NOT NULL THEN f.chave_cte
        ELSE NULL
    END AS [Documento Oficial/Chave]

columns.name: Documento Oficial/Número
columns.legacyExpression:
CASE

          OR f.serie_cte IS NOT NULL THEN CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), f.numero_cte)
        WHEN f.nfse_number IS NOT NULL
          OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(f.nfse_series)), '') IS NOT NULL
          OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(f.nfse_xml_document)), '') IS NOT NULL
          OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(f.nfse_integration_id)), '') IS NOT NULL THEN CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), f.nfse_number)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS [Documento Oficial/Número]

columns.name: Documento Oficial/Série
columns.legacyExpression:
CASE 
        WHEN f.cte_id IS NOT NULL
          OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(f.chave_cte)), '') IS NOT NULL
          OR f.numero_cte IS NOT NULL
          OR f.serie_cte IS NOT NULL THEN CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), f.serie_cte)
        WHEN f.nfse_number IS NOT NULL

          OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(f.nfse_xml_document)), '') IS NOT NULL
          OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(f.nfse_integration_id)), '') IS NOT NULL THEN f.nfse_series
        ELSE NULL
    END AS [Documento Oficial/Série]

columns.name: Documento Oficial/XML
columns.legacyExpression:
CASE 
        WHEN f.cte_id IS NOT NULL
          OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(f.chave_cte)), '') IS NOT NULL
          OR f.numero_cte IS NOT NULL
          OR f.serie_cte IS NOT NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN f.nfse_number IS NOT NULL
          OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(f.nfse_series)), '') IS NOT NULL
          OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(f.nfse_xml_document)), '') IS NOT NULL
          OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(f.nfse_integration_id)), '') IS NOT NULL THEN f.nfse_xml_document

columns.name: Responsável pela Região de Destino
columns.legacyExpression: indicador_base.filial_responsavel_destino AS [Responsável pela Região de Destino]

columns.name: Performance Status
columns.legacyExpression:
CASE
        WHEN indicador_perf.performance_diferenca_dias IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN indicador_perf.performance_diferenca_dias <= 0 THEN 'NO PRAZO'
        ELSE 'FORA DO PRAZO'
    END AS [Performance Status]

columns.name: Performance Status Dif de Dias
columns.legacyExpression:
CASE
        WHEN indicador_perf.performance_diferenca_dias IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN indicador_perf.performance_diferenca_dias = 0 THEN 'NO PRAZO'
        WHEN indicador_perf.performance_diferenca_dias = 1 THEN '1 DIA DE ATRASO'
        WHEN indicador_perf.performance_diferenca_dias = 2 THEN '2 DIAS DE ATRASO'
        WHEN indicador_perf.performance_diferenca_dias = 3 THEN '3 DIAS DE ATRASO'
        WHEN indicador_perf.performance_diferenca_dias > 3 THEN 'ACIMA DE 3 DIAS DE ATRASO'
        WHEN indicador_perf.performance_diferenca_dias = -1 THEN '1 DIA ANTES'
        WHEN indicador_perf.performance_diferenca_dias = -2 THEN '2 DIAS ANTES'
        WHEN indicador_perf.performance_diferenca_dias = -3 THEN '3 DIAS ANTES'
        ELSE 'ACIMA DE 3 DIAS ANTES'
    END AS [Performance Status Dif de Dias]

columns.name: Performance Status Dif de Dias Oficial
columns.legacyExpression:
CASE
        WHEN indicador_perf.performance_diferenca_dias IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN indicador_perf.performance_diferenca_dias = 0 THEN 'NO PRAZO'
        WHEN indicador_perf.performance_diferenca_dias = 1 THEN '1 DIA DE ATRASO'
        WHEN indicador_perf.performance_diferenca_dias = 2 THEN '2 DIAS DE ATRASO'
        WHEN indicador_perf.performance_diferenca_dias = 3 THEN '3 DIAS DE ATRASO'
        WHEN indicador_perf.performance_diferenca_dias > 3 THEN 'ACIMA DE 3 DIAS DE ATRASO'
        WHEN indicador_perf.performance_diferenca_dias = -1 THEN '1 DIA ANTES'
        WHEN indicador_perf.performance_diferenca_dias = -2 THEN '2 DIAS ANTES'
        WHEN indicador_perf.performance_diferenca_dias = -3 THEN '3 DIAS ANTES'
        ELSE 'ACIMA DE 3 DIAS ANTES'
    END AS [Performance Status Dif de Dias Oficial]

columns.name: Comprovante Anexado
columns.legacyExpression:
CASE
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.inventario AS inv
            WHERE inv.numero_minuta = f.corporation_sequence_number
              AND inv.flag_comprovante_anexado = 1
              AND COALESCE(inv.excluido_na_origem, 0) = 0
        )
            THEN N'Sim'
        ELSE N'Não'
    END AS [Comprovante Anexado]

columns.name: Status
columns.legacyExpression:
CASE f.status
        WHEN 'pending' THEN 'pendente'
        WHEN 'finished' THEN 'finalizado'
        WHEN 'done' THEN 'finalizado'
        WHEN 'canceled' THEN 'cancelada'
        WHEN 'cancelled' THEN 'cancelada'
        WHEN 'in_transit' THEN 'em trânsito'
        WHEN 'standby' THEN 'aguardando'
        WHEN 'manifested' THEN 'registrado'
        WHEN 'occurrence_treatment' THEN 'tratamento de ocorrência'
        ELSE f.status
    END AS [Status]

columns.name: Cortesia
columns.legacyExpression:
CASE WHEN f.cortesia = 1 THEN 'Sim'
         WHEN f.cortesia = 0 THEN 'Não'
         ELSE NULL
    END AS [Cortesia]

columns.name: Seguro Habilitado
columns.legacyExpression:
CASE WHEN f.insurance_enabled = 1 THEN 'Com seguro'
         WHEN f.insurance_enabled = 0 THEN 'Sem seguro'
         ELSE NULL
    END AS [Seguro Habilitado]

columns.name: Tipo Pagamento
columns.legacyExpression:
CASE f.payment_type
        WHEN 'bill' THEN 'cobrança'
        WHEN 'cash' THEN 'dinheiro'
        ELSE f.payment_type
    END AS [Tipo Pagamento]

columns.name: Doc Anterior

CASE f.previous_document_type

        ELSE f.previous_document_type

columns.name: Possui DIFAL

CASE WHEN f.fiscal_has_difal = 1 THEN 'possui'

    END AS [Possui DIFAL]

columns.name: Globalizado
columns.legacyExpression:
CASE WHEN f.globalized = 1 THEN 'verdadeiro'
         WHEN f.globalized = 0 THEN 'falso'
         ELSE NULL
    END AS [Globalizado]

columns.name: Tipo Globalizado
columns.legacyExpression:
CASE f.globalized_type
        WHEN 'none' THEN 'nenhum'
        ELSE f.globalized_type
    END AS [Tipo Globalizado]

columns.name: Status
columns.legacyExpression:
CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(c.excluido_na_origem, 0) = 1
          OR COALESCE(c.confirmacoes_ausencia_origem, 0) >= 1
            THEN N'Excluída'
        ELSE COALESCE(status_coleta.rotulo_powerbi, c.status)
    END AS [Status]

columns.legacyExpression: CAST(COALESCE(c.excluido_na_origem, 0) AS BIT) AS [Excluída na Origem]

columns.name: Região Logística
columns.legacyExpression:
COALESCE(
        regra_cep.regiao_logistica,
        regra_cidade.regiao_logistica,
        CONCAT(
            COALESCE(coleta_local.cidade_limpa, N'Sem cidade'),
            N' - ',
            COALESCE(coleta_local.uf_limpa, N'Sem UF')
        )
    ) AS [Região Logística]

columns.name: Min. Frete/KG
columns.legacyExpression:
CASE
        WHEN origin_state = 'SP' AND destination_state = 'SP' THEN 0.66
        WHEN origin_state = 'SP' AND destination_state = 'RJ' THEN 1.21
        WHEN origin_state = 'SP' AND destination_state = 'PR' THEN 0.74
        WHEN origin_state = 'SP' AND destination_state = 'RS' THEN 1.70
        WHEN origin_state = 'SP' AND destination_state = 'PE' THEN 1.54
        WHEN origin_state = 'RJ' AND destination_state = 'SP' THEN 1.21
        WHEN origin_state = 'RJ' AND destination_state = 'RJ' THEN 0.66
        WHEN origin_state = 'RJ' AND destination_state = 'PR' THEN 0.98
        WHEN origin_state = 'RJ' AND destination_state = 'RS' THEN 2.08
        WHEN origin_state = 'RJ' AND destination_state = 'PE' THEN 1.95
        WHEN origin_state = 'PR' AND destination_state = 'SP' THEN 0.74
        WHEN origin_state = 'PR' AND destination_state = 'RJ' THEN 0.88
        WHEN origin_state = 'PR' AND destination_state = 'PR' THEN 0.55
        WHEN origin_state = 'PR' AND destination_state = 'RS' THEN 0.98
        WHEN origin_state = 'PR' AND destination_state = 'PE' THEN 1.83
        WHEN origin_state = 'RS' AND destination_state = 'SP' THEN 1.70
        WHEN origin_state = 'RS' AND destination_state = 'RJ' THEN 1.95
        WHEN origin_state = 'RS' AND destination_state = 'PR' THEN 1.46
        WHEN origin_state = 'RS' AND destination_state = 'RS' THEN 0.98
        WHEN origin_state = 'RS' AND destination_state = 'PE' THEN 2.20
        WHEN origin_state = 'PE' AND destination_state = 'SP' THEN 1.46
        WHEN origin_state = 'PE' AND destination_state = 'RJ' THEN 2.20
        WHEN origin_state = 'PE' AND destination_state = 'PR' THEN 2.20
        WHEN origin_state = 'PE' AND destination_state = 'RS' THEN 2.32
        WHEN origin_state = 'PE' AND destination_state = 'PE' THEN 0.55
        ELSE 0.00
    END                                             AS [Min. Frete/KG]

CASE lc.status
        WHEN 'pending' THEN 'Pendente'
        WHEN 'delivering' THEN 'Em entrega'
        WHEN 'in_warehouse' THEN 'Em armazém'
        WHEN 'in_transfer' THEN 'Em transferência'
        WHEN 'manifested' THEN 'Manifestado'
        WHEN 'finished' THEN 'Finalizado'
        WHEN 'delivered' THEN 'Entregue'

    END AS [Status Carga]

columns.name: Status Terminal
